evidence.text: For 0→7/9 ML, acidic Volmer 0.43→0.89 eV and Heyrovsky 0.80→0.25 eV; alkaline Volmer 0.99→1.57 eV and Heyrovsky 1.03→0.60 eV. Thus coverage increases Volmer barriers and decreases Heyrovsky barriers.

The source polynomial barriers at acid U=0 V are Volmer 0.4246/0.8846 and Heyrovsky 0.7954/0.2508 eV (0/7-9 ML); at alkaline U=-0.826 V, Volmer 0.9856884/1.5739156 and Heyrovsky 1.0335233/0.6029640 eV. These are source references, not independent new DFT results.
